reviews.review_msg: I enjoyed taking audit with Nahla. The lectures were engaging and the exams were fair, based on the lectures and in-class assignments. However, there was a lot of homework on Pearson (Pre-Lecture and Post-Lecture) based on the textbook which sometimes conflicted with what was taught in class. Group project was a bit disorganized, but doable.

She wants you to do well and encourages questions, engagement and class participation. Came in when the scheduled prof cancelled and canvas was out, so some things weren't well planned, including the group project which was unclear and Pearson homework which didn't align with lecture material. Still a good instructor and highly recommended.
